title: Extended fleet observability correlation pack
notes: This pack extends host-runtime observability beyond the core SIEM nodes.
It focuses on Proxmox-backed monitored guests that are operational dependencies or business services.
Noise is controlled through the existing host-runtime suppression policy and the targeted host filter below.
Suppression key: host.name + service.name + rule family. Escalation requires the configured threshold inside the declared window.

stream_rules.title: Extended Fleet Telemetry Missing
stream_rules.operator_action: Validate the guest power state, host-runtime agent, rsyslog path, and ingest reachability.
stream_rules.sigma_yaml:
title: Extended Fleet Telemetry Missing
id: sigma-extended-fleet-telemetry-missing
status: experimental
logsource:
  product: infrastructure
  service: host_metrics
detection:
  selection:
    event.provider: host.metrics
    event.type: host_telemetry_stale
    host.name:
      - nextcloud-siem
      - navidrome-01
      - vuln-mgr-01
      - pilot-web-01
      - pilot-db-01
      - pilot-cache-01
      - openclaw-gateway
  condition: selection
level: high
tags:
  - platform.fleet
  - platform.telemetry
  - platform.stale
